title: Writing 写作
paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a response essay. Some students say that although a university campus offers rich resources, such as libraries, laboratories, lecture series and online databases, many students make little use of them. Write an essay in which you respond to this view and offer suggestions on how students can make better use of campus resources for their academic development. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference:
The resources available on a university campus are indeed impressive, yet it is true that many students use only a small part of them. In my view, the problem is not a lack of resources but a lack of guidance and habit.

Libraries subscribe to expensive databases that students discover only in their final year, laboratories stand empty at weekends, and public lectures are attended mostly by the lecturers themselves. To change this, universities should introduce students to these resources in their first term, for example through a short course that shows them how to search academic databases, book equipment and join a research group. Students should also set themselves a weekly goal, such as attending one lecture outside their subject or spending two hours in the library.

Resources only become valuable when they are used. With better guidance and a little curiosity, students can turn the campus into a powerful partner in their studies.
